candidates.title: Require BGP neighbor authentication on WAN eBGP
candidates.summary: Unauthenticated eBGP peers remain a route-injection risk on edge/WAN. Lab already checks adjacency up; it does not assert password/TCP-AO.
candidates.why_network: Directly affects WAN/edge routing protocol security between peers.
candidates.pci_dss_footnote: Supports secure network controls / restrict untrusted routes (conceptual; QSA validates).
candidates.disa_footnote: Aligns with Cisco RTR STIG routing-protocol authentication themes.
candidates.suggested_assert: config_contains on each WAN device: neighbor line has password, keychain, or TCP-AO

candidates.title: Disable cleartext HTTP device management
candidates.summary: Management plane should not expose ip http server on IOS-XE edges.
candidates.why_network: Router/switch administrative access path — not application security.
candidates.pci_dss_footnote: Encrypted administrative access themes in DSS 4.x (footnote).
candidates.suggested_assert: config_contains asserting no 'ip http server' line is present

skipped_non_network: MP-6 media protection / portable device — no endpoints in prod.json
